# hyperfluid_bucket_credentials (Data Source)

Derived S3 credentials for an existing bucket. **The `secret_key` is written to Terraform state — treat state as sensitive** (use an encrypted remote backend).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_env" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

# Mint the derived S3 credentials for an existing bucket. The secret_key is
# stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted remote backend.
data "hyperfluid_bucket_credentials" "lake" {
  env         = data.hyperfluid_env.default.id
  bucket_name = "data-lake"
}

output "bucket_endpoint" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_bucket_credentials.lake.endpoint
}

output "bucket_access_key" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_bucket_credentials.lake.access_key
}

output "bucket_secret_key" {
  value     = data.hyperfluid_bucket_credentials.lake.secret_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket name to mint credentials for.
- `env` (String) Environment id the bucket lives in.

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String) S3 access key id.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint the credentials authenticate against.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier `env/bucket_name`.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key.
